tab1_celulas.titulo: Table 1. Cells of the faithful port: design and rejection at 5% (500 datasets, 1,000 permutations each)
tab1_celulas.fonte: Source: the study's `results.json` (outputs with verified sha256). Municipality with no gap: 10 observations. The real-mask rows use only the information on which municipality-periods have the index; the outcome is synthetic. Effect = share of variance due to the mayor; 0% = true null. Observations used = municipality-periods that enter the test after the gap and, under `nostitch`, after dropping blocks with a single mayor; not recorded (—) in the scale and real-mask cells. In the cells with a period-9 gap and `nostitch`, the observations used include period 10, a one-row block that is never shuffled and does not contribute to the variation across permutations when its mayor does not appear in the other block. Municipalities = units that enter the cell before `nostitch` drops blocks.
